reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, linkBankSyncAccount and the import pipeline, but copies an existing downloader and local unlink logic.

duplication.why: The diff duplicates Akahu's downloader, unlinkAccount's field-reset block and the closed-account rejection.

placement.why: Changes follow the existing module boundaries, although link validation and execution are split across provider handlers and the shared linking function.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the four requested linking and provider changes.

maintainability.why: The design preserves useful shared linking machinery but adds duplicated policies and caller-managed release IDs that increase coordination during future changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra uses the existing bank-selection and account-linking abstractions; unlinkAccount includes remote side effects and offers no reusable local-only operation.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadAkahuTransactions with renamed provider references and a const result; releaseAccountLinks wraps unlinkAccount's existing field-reset block in a loop.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared helpers gain replaceExistingLink and accountIdsToRelease; policy branches cover duplicate-link refusal with replacement permission and closed-account rejection in both assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount, while all six provider handlers retain shared calls.
